title: Tachyon job analytics
description: Per-job phase records from ClickHouse: pickup, prebuild savings, cache, oversubscription slowdown and cost.

panels.title: Pickup p50 / p95 by region and size

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(runner_online_at) AS time,
       concat(region, ' ', toString(vcpu), 'x') AS series,
       quantile(0.5)(pickup_seconds) AS p50,
       quantile(0.95)(pickup_seconds) AS p95
FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(runner_online_at) AND pickup_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT repo,
       count() AS jobs,
       countIf(prebuild_match = 'full') / count() AS full,
       countIf(prebuild_match = 'partial') / count() AS partial,
       countIf(prebuild_match = 'none') / count() AS none,
       quantileIf(0.5)(run_seconds, prebuild_match = 'none') AS median_run_s_cold,
       quantileIf(0.5)(run_seconds, prebuild_match = 'full') AS median_run_s_warm
FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(job_finished_at)
GROUP BY repo
ORDER BY jobs DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Minutes saved by prebuilds
panels.description: Per repo and size: median cold run time minus each warm job's run time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cold AS (
    SELECT repo, vcpu, quantile(0.5)(run_seconds) AS cold_s
    FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
    WHERE prebuild_match = 'none' AND run_seconds IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(job_finished_at)
    GROUP BY repo, vcpu
)
SELECT $__timeInterval(j.job_finished_at) AS time,
       sum(greatest(c.cold_s - j.run_seconds, 0)) / 60 AS minutes_saved
FROM tachyon.job_records AS j FINAL
INNER JOIN cold AS c USING (repo, vcpu)
WHERE j.prebuild_match IN ('full', 'partial') AND $__timeFilter(j.job_finished_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT repo,
       sum(cache_hits) AS hits,
       sum(cache_misses) AS misses,
       hits / nullIf(hits + misses, 0) AS hit_rate
FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(job_finished_at)
GROUP BY repo
ORDER BY hits + misses DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Oversubscription slowdown (normalized per repo and size)
panels.description: Each oversubscribed job's run time over its repo's median on a non-oversubscribed host. The scheduler steps back above 1.10.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT repo, vcpu, quantile(0.5)(run_seconds) AS med
    FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
    WHERE host_load <= 1 AND run_seconds IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(job_finished_at)
    GROUP BY repo, vcpu
)
SELECT $__timeInterval(j.job_finished_at) AS time,
       quantile(0.5)(j.run_seconds / b.med) AS median_slowdown,
       quantile(0.9)(j.run_seconds / b.med) AS p90_slowdown
FROM tachyon.job_records AS j FINAL
INNER JOIN base AS b USING (repo, vcpu)
WHERE j.host_load > 1 AND j.run_seconds IS NOT NULL AND b.med > 0 AND $__timeFilter(j.job_finished_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost per job-minute, owned vs burst

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(job_finished_at) AS time,
       capacity,
       sum(cost_usd) / nullIf(sum(billable_seconds) / 60, 0) AS usd_per_job_minute
FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(job_finished_at) AND billable_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time, capacity
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Billable minutes and cost by tenant

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tenant,
       count() AS jobs,
       sum(billable_seconds) / 60 AS billable_minutes,
       sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
       countIf(outcome = 'infra_error') AS infra_errors
FROM tachyon.job_records FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(job_finished_at)
GROUP BY tenant
ORDER BY billable_minutes DESC
